title: Building verifiable databases at scale from the chemical literature via a multi-agent system
abstract: arXiv:2507.20230v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accelerating chemical research with artificial intelligence requires high-quality databases. However, many reactions exist only as graphics drawn for human readers, which machines must read exactly. Specialist software is precise but rigid, whereas multimodal language models are flexible yet often write incorrect structures; neither flags errors. We present ChemEAGLE, a multi-agent system where tools supply structures and a language model extends their reach through judgments that programs apply. On 424 published graphics, its F1 score for exactly correct reactions was 82.2%, against 47.7% for a tool-equipped generalist agent, and calibrated confidence limited review to 35% of reactions at 96.6% accuracy. Without review, it built a 60,103-reaction photochemistry database whose records trained models to rank conditions and predict products. Verifiable databases can thus be built at scale.

translated_title: 通过多智能体系统从化学文献中大规模构建可验证数据库
translated_abstract: 用人工智能加速化学研究需要高质量的数据库。然而，许多反应仅以供人类阅读的图形形式存在，机器必须精确读取这些图形。专业软件精确但僵化，而多模态语言模型灵活却经常写出错误的结构；两者都不会标记错误。我们提出了ChemEAGLE，这是一个多智能体系统，其中工具提供化学结构，语言模型通过程序应用的判断来扩展其能力。在424个已发表的图形上，其完全正确反应的F1分数为82.2%，而配备工具的通用智能体仅为47.7%；且校准后的置信度将需人工审核的反应限制在35%以内，准确率达96.6%。在无需审核的情况下，它构建了一个包含60,103个反应的光化学数据库，其记录训练的模型可用于排序反应条件和预测产物。因此，可验证的数据库能够大规模构建。
tldr: ChemEAGLE多智能体系统通过工具提供结构、语言模型做出判断的方式，从化学文献图形中精确提取反应（F1达82.2%），并大规模构建了包含6万余个反应的可验证光化学数据库。
en_tdlr: ChemEAGLE, a multi-agent system where tools supply structures and language model judgments extend their reach, extracts reactions from chemical literature graphics with high accuracy (F1 of 82.2%) and enables large-scale construction of verifiable databases, exemplified by a 60,103-reaction photochemistry database.
